data.name: Robologs
data.detailed_description:
Robologs is a fast-paced arcade shooter where you fight against out-of-control zombie robots.

Survive in abandoned and dangerous areas against a relentless robot army. Choose your character and weapons, try different playstyles, and see how long you can last as the battles become more challenging. Fight alone or team up with your friends.

Robologs is not only about survival, but also aims to offer different game modes where players can compete with each other. Modes like Deathmatch and Race Mode are currently in development. These modes are not yet available and are marked as “Soon” in the game.

As development continues, these modes will become playable and the game experience will expand. Our goal is to improve both competitive and fun multiplayer gameplay and deliver more content over time.

Gear up, plan your strategy, and see how far you can go in your fight against zombie robots. Survival in the world of Robologs won’t be easy — but it will be worth it.

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: i5 3550 / RYZEN 5 2500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD R9 270X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
